title: Graduate Software Engineering Programme
description: Two-year rotational programme for recent graduates in computing or a related subject. Includes mentoring and paid professional certifications.

title: Summer Internship – Public Health Research
description: Ten-week paid internship supporting community health research projects. Suitable for undergraduates in health or social sciences.

title: Level 3 Engineering Apprenticeship
description: Earn while you learn: a three-year apprenticeship in electrical engineering with day-release college study.

title: NextGen Mentoring Circles
description: Small groups of four to six members matched with an experienced ZOCF professional for monthly online sessions over six months.

title: Diaspora Business Pitch Night
description: Pitch your business idea to a friendly panel of entrepreneurs. Feedback for everyone and a small seed prize for the winning idea.

title: Volunteer Event Coordinators
description: Help plan and run community events, from food banks to cultural days. Great experience for your CV.

title: Free Data Skills Bootcamp
description: Twelve-week evening course covering spreadsheets, SQL and data visualisation, with job-interview support at the end.

title: Postgraduate Study Open Evenings
description: Information sessions on funding, applications and life as a postgraduate student, led by current students.

title: STEM Undergraduate Scholarship
description: Annual bursary towards tuition and living costs for students of African heritage studying science, technology, engineering or maths.

title: Young Community Leaders Programme
description: A six-month programme building leadership, public speaking and project management skills through a real community project.
